description.en: Chinese classical poetry viewer for DeepSeek Harness Web: adds a poetry tab to the conversation view with token-free search over a public 370k-poem API, dynasty and author filters, feihualing prompts, a daily poem, favorites, share cards, and AI explanation through the user's own session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 诗词查看插件：会话页新增「诗词」标签页，基于公开免费接口（37 万首）提供免 token 搜索、按朝代/作者筛选、飞花令、每日一首、收藏、分享卡片，AI 解读复用用户自己的会话。
